name: leaflet-basic-map
description: Interactive Earthquake Mapping using GeoJSON data from earthquake.usgs.gov.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && parcel build index.html --dist-dir dist --public-url ./
scripts.format:check: prettier --check README.md THIRD_PARTY_DATA.md .github/workflows/api.yml index.html wdc-usga-gov.html static/js/app.js static/js/earthquake-data.js static/scss/app.scss tests/*.test.mjs && prettier --check .parcelrc --parser json
scripts.test: npm run format:check && npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run test:dist

author: Jovani Pink
